scoring_justification: Full CI-NEB recompute is computationally prohibitive in the verifier sandbox. Instead, compare agent's reported values against paper-reported Table 1 values with tolerances (±0.05 eV for activation energy, factor of 2 for diffusion coefficient).

hidden_assets.purpose: hidden gold activation energies and diffusion coefficients for seven impurity-lattice systems
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: these are the paper’s own published values, the target of the reproduction

outputs.description: Activation energies and diffusion coefficients for Ag+, Li+, and H+ diffusion in PbS and Ag2S lattices (seven rows).

output_contract.notes: The agent must compute E_a and D via CI-NEB. The hidden checker compares each value against the paper-reported reference within tolerances (activation energy ±0.05 eV, diffusion coefficient within a factor of 2).

steps.description: Compare activation energy and diffusion coefficient for each of the seven systems against hidden paper gold with tolerances
